verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs describe an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API that works with any OpenAI SDK or client. They also cover the Anthropic Messages and Open Responses APIs, the OpenAI functions/tools API, a /models/apply management endpoint and per-user API keys, so the product can be driven programmatically. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt on the docs site, though they did not check the running server, so this does not contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec or full endpoint reference, and independent hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
